CREATE TRIGGER ledger_owner_insert BEFORE INSERT ON ledger_entries
  WHEN NEW.account_id IS NOT (SELECT account_id FROM income_sources WHERE id = NEW.source_id)
    OR (NEW.item_id IS NOT NULL
        AND NEW.account_id IS NOT (SELECT account_id FROM compensation_items WHERE id = NEW.item_id))
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'EARNLENS_ACCOUNT_MISMATCH');
END;

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "accounts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "avatar_emoji" TEXT NULL, "color_index" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "avatar_image" TEXT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "locale" TEXT NULL, "monthly_target_minor" INTEGER NULL, "requires_pin" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("requires_pin" IN (0, 1)), "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TRIGGER account_limit BEFORE INSERT ON accounts WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM accounts) >= 10 BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'EARNLENS_ACCOUNT_LIMIT');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "income_sources" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "custom_category" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "end_date" TEXT NULL, "accrual_policy" TEXT NOT NULL, "work_weekday_mask" INTEGER NOT NULL, "work_start_minute" INTEGER NOT NULL, "work_end_minute" INTEGER NOT NULL, "pay_rule" TEXT NOT NULL, "pay_day" INTEGER NOT NULL, "pay_offset_months" INTEGER NOT NULL, "weekend_adjust" TEXT NOT NULL, "expected_pay_date" TEXT NULL, "fixed_total_minor" INTEGER NULL, "fixed_total_accrual" TEXT NOT NULL, "forecast_method" TEXT NOT NULL, "employer" TEXT NULL, "take_home_minor" INTEGER NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "color_index" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "is_sample" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_sample" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TRIGGER sources_owner_fixed BEFORE UPDATE OF account_id ON income_sources WHEN NEW.account_id <> OLD.account_id BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'EARNLENS_ACCOUNT_MISMATCH');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "rate_revisions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES income_sources (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "effective_from" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "period" TEXT NOT NULL, "change_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "percent_bps" INTEGER NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TRIGGER revisions_owner_insert BEFORE INSERT ON rate_revisions WHEN NEW.account_id IS NOT (SELECT account_id FROM income_sources WHERE id = NEW.source_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'EARNLENS_ACCOUNT_MISMATCH');END

CREATE TRIGGER revisions_owner_update BEFORE UPDATE OF account_id, source_id ON rate_revisions WHEN NEW.account_id IS NOT (SELECT account_id FROM income_sources WHERE id = NEW.source_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'EARNLENS_ACCOUNT_MISMATCH');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "source_pauses" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES income_sources (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "start" TEXT NOT NULL, "end_exclusive" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TRIGGER pauses_owner_insert BEFORE INSERT ON source_pauses WHEN NEW.account_id IS NOT (SELECT account_id FROM income_sources WHERE id = NEW.source_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'EARNLENS_ACCOUNT_MISMATCH');END

CREATE TRIGGER pauses_owner_update BEFORE UPDATE OF account_id, source_id ON source_pauses WHEN NEW.account_id IS NOT (SELECT account_id FROM income_sources WHERE id = NEW.source_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'EARNLENS_ACCOUNT_MISMATCH');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "day_overrides" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "source_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES income_sources (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TRIGGER overrides_owner_insert BEFORE INSERT ON day_overrides WHEN NEW.source_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.account_id IS NOT (SELECT account_id FROM income_sources WHERE id = NEW.source_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'EARNLENS_ACCOUNT_MISMATCH');END

CREATE TRIGGER overrides_owner_update BEFORE UPDATE OF account_id, source_id ON day_overrides WHEN NEW.source_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.account_id IS NOT (SELECT account_id FROM income_sources WHERE id = NEW.source_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'EARNLENS_ACCOUNT_MISMATCH');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "compensation_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "source_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES income_sources (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "expected_minor" INTEGER NULL, "expected_date" TEXT NULL, "actual_minor" INTEGER NULL, "earned_date" TEXT NULL, "recurrence" TEXT NOT NULL, "non_cash" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("non_cash" IN (0, 1)), "counts_as_earnings" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("counts_as_earnings" IN (0, 1)), "include_in_forecast" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("include_in_forecast" IN (0, 1)), "tax_note" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "cancelled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("cancelled" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TRIGGER items_owner_insert BEFORE INSERT ON compensation_items WHEN NEW.source_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.account_id IS NOT (SELECT account_id FROM income_sources WHERE id = NEW.source_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'EARNLENS_ACCOUNT_MISMATCH');END

CREATE TRIGGER items_owner_update BEFORE UPDATE OF account_id, source_id ON compensation_items WHEN NEW.source_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.account_id IS NOT (SELECT account_id FROM income_sources WHERE id = NEW.source_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'EARNLENS_ACCOUNT_MISMATCH');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "monthly_records" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES income_sources (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "month" TEXT NOT NULL, "original_estimate_minor" INTEGER NULL, "revised_estimate_minor" INTEGER NULL, "actual_minor" INTEGER NULL, "finalized" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("finalized" IN (0, 1)), "finalized_at" INTEGER NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("source_id", "month"));

CREATE TRIGGER monthly_owner_insert BEFORE INSERT ON monthly_records WHEN NEW.account_id IS NOT (SELECT account_id FROM income_sources WHERE id = NEW.source_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'EARNLENS_ACCOUNT_MISMATCH');END

CREATE TRIGGER monthly_owner_update BEFORE UPDATE OF account_id, source_id ON monthly_records WHEN NEW.account_id IS NOT (SELECT account_id FROM income_sources WHERE id = NEW.source_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'EARNLENS_ACCOUNT_MISMATCH');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ledger_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES income_sources (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "item_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES compensation_items (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "period_month" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "dedupe_key" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "notes" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TRIGGER ledger_owner_insert BEFORE INSERT ON ledger_entries WHEN NEW.account_id IS NOT (SELECT account_id FROM income_sources WHERE id = NEW.source_id) OR(NEW.item_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.account_id IS NOT (SELECT account_id FROM compensation_items WHERE id = NEW.item_id))BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'EARNLENS_ACCOUNT_MISMATCH');END

CREATE TRIGGER ledger_owner_update BEFORE UPDATE OF account_id, source_id, item_id ON ledger_entries WHEN NEW.account_id IS NOT (SELECT account_id FROM income_sources WHERE id = NEW.source_id) OR(NEW.item_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.account_id IS NOT (SELECT account_id FROM compensation_items WHERE id = NEW.item_id))BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'EARNLENS_ACCOUNT_MISMATCH');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "calendar_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES income_sources (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "amount_minor" INTEGER NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "remind" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("remind" IN (0, 1)), "cancelled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("cancelled" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TRIGGER events_owner_insert BEFORE INSERT ON calendar_events WHEN NEW.source_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.account_id IS NOT (SELECT account_id FROM income_sources WHERE id = NEW.source_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'EARNLENS_ACCOUNT_MISMATCH');END

CREATE TRIGGER events_owner_update BEFORE UPDATE OF account_id, source_id ON calendar_events WHEN NEW.source_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.account_id IS NOT (SELECT account_id FROM income_sources WHERE id = NEW.source_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'EARNLENS_ACCOUNT_MISMATCH');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "profiles" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "locale" TEXT NOT NULL, "timezone" TEXT NOT NULL, "date_of_birth" TEXT NULL, "onboarding_complete" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("onboarding_complete" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "combined_accounts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "avatar_emoji" TEXT NULL, "color_index" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "avatar_image" TEXT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "member_key" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "combined_account_members" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "combined_account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES combined_accounts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("combined_account_id", "account_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "audit_log" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "action" TEXT NOT NULL, "summary" TEXT NOT NULL, "before_json" TEXT NULL, "after_json" TEXT NULL, "at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "notification_history" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "scheduled_for" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE INDEX idx_combined_members_account ON combined_account_members (account_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_sources_account ON income_sources (account_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_rate_revisions_source ON rate_revisions (source_id, effective_from)
CREATE INDEX idx_revisions_account ON rate_revisions (account_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_pauses_account ON source_pauses (account_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_day_overrides_date ON day_overrides (date)
CREATE INDEX idx_overrides_account ON day_overrides (account_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_items_source ON compensation_items (source_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_items_account ON compensation_items (account_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_monthly_account ON monthly_records (account_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_ledger_source_period ON ledger_entries (source_id, period_month)
CREATE INDEX idx_ledger_date ON ledger_entries (date)
CREATE INDEX idx_ledger_account ON ledger_entries (account_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_events_date ON calendar_events (date)
CREATE INDEX idx_events_account ON calendar_events (account_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_audit_entity ON audit_log (entity_type, entity_id)
